question: 一共有多少个有效订单？
clarification: 按下单时间还是支付时间
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'completed')

question: 列出产品型号、名称和价格
sql: SELECT model_code, name, list_price FROM products ORDER BY model_code LIMIT 200

question: 各型号的平均满意度是多少？
sql: SELECT p.model_code, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS survey_count FROM satisfaction_surveys s JOIN tickets t ON t.id=s.ticket_id JOIN devices d ON d.id=t.device_id JOIN products p ON p.id=d.product_id GROUP BY p.model_code ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 200

question: 哪些设备在首次报修后7天内再次报修？按型号和故障类型汇总
sql: WITH ordered_tickets AS (SELECT t.id,t.device_id,t.fault_code_id,t.created_at,LAG(t.created_at) OVER(PARTITION BY t.device_id ORDER BY t.created_at) previous_at FROM tickets t WHERE t.status <> 'cancelled') SELECT p.model_code,f.category AS fault_category,COUNT(*) AS repeat_ticket_count FROM ordered_tickets ot JOIN devices d ON d.id=ot.device_id JOIN products p ON p.id=d.product_id LEFT JOIN fault_codes f ON f.id=ot.fault_code_id WHERE ot.previous_at IS NOT NULL AND ot.created_at <= ot.previous_at + INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY p.model_code,f.category ORDER BY repeat_ticket_count DESC LIMIT 200
